text:
nora: Heads-up: two pilot customersasked for a light-weight Optimize Toolkit alpha. Need to lock a minimal scope and clear pass/fail checks by end of week so sales can sign.

sam: From eng: propose a minimal deliverable that only suggests changes (no auto-apply): 1) batching recommendation API with estimated p50/p95 and token-cost delta; 2) prefix-caching suggestion API plus a measurement endpoint that can replay prefixes to estimate hit rate; 3) quantization report API that shows expected quality delta and throughput gain (no automatic quant). Also an alerting adapter that compares eval outputs to baseline and emits a webhook when a metric regresses beyond threshold.

leo: I'll prepare a short compatibility sheet marking safe quant modes per model family and flag models we must never recommend for quant. I can also run quick bench comparisons for 3 common models.

anya: CS asks for an "explain" field on every recommendation (one sentence) and a tiny confidence score (low/med/high). Pilot customers want the ability to accept recommendations manually via a toggle in the dashboard.

ravi: Sales/SRE note: pilots require a canary route + automatic fallback to hosted inference when latency or error rates exceed configured SLOs. We need a scripted rollback and SRE sign-off before starting.

sam: Example smoke command (returns recommendations + rough numbers):

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/suggest \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"payments-chat","seq_len":128,"model":"red-mx-7b"}'

Expected: a short JSON with batching:{strategy, expected_p50_ms_delta, token_savings_pct}, cache:{estimated_prefix_hit_pct, measurement_endpoint}, quant:{mode, est_quality_delta_pct, est_throughput_x}, explanation:"short repeated prompts -> prefix caching + small batch window recommended", confidence:"med"

nora: Gating thresholds suggestion: - primary quality metric drop <=1.5% during pilot; - token cost reduction >=10% OR p50 latency improvement >=12% for batching/quant to be considered successful; - alerts default to 5% regression. These are negotiable but we need numbers to sign pilots.

leo: For the quant report, call out which eval metric was used (e.g., F1/ROUGE) and include sample size. Also include a note when results are noisy.

anya: Pilot acceptance checklist: onboarding doc + runbook, 2-week schedule, baseline vs pilot dashboard, rollback tested, SRE contact listed, and weekly checkpoint meetings.

sam: Rough dev breakdown: rec API + measurement endpoint = 3w, quant benching + comp sheet = 1.5w, eval-alert adapter + webhook = 1.5w, dashboard stub + toggle = 1.5w. Parallel work so target 4-5w to alpha.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: tentative deploy window reserved 2024-06-20 01:00 UTC.

nora: Decision: lock minimal alpha to the suggested items above unless major objections. Please respond with :thumbsup: if you can deliver or list blockers. We need sign-off by Friday COB to enroll pilots next week.
